title: Chapter 350 Returning To Jiang'S House
content:
Chapter 350 Returning To Jiang'S House

Upon hearing this, Lin Ye immediately understood that Lu Daosheng was asking himself.

"This, Mr. Lu, haven't I said it? This is from my Lin family's ancestors."

Linye smiled.

Ordinary people may really believe the words of forestry.

After all, there is no problem with a bottle of wine passed down from ancestors.

But Lu Daosheng is not an ordinary person.

Can a family in a second-tier city have such a level of wine?

Lu Daosheng dares to assert that looking at the entire China, he may not be able to find a second altar.

That's right, this wine has no value in Lu Daosheng's eyes. I'll try it a lot, but it's one of the rare treasures with extremely high value in Blue Star.

Forestry, obviously, didn't tell the truth.

"I don't want to ask again, where did you come from this wine?"

Lu Daosheng's painting style turned sharply, and his voice was slightly gloomy.

For a moment, forestry was like falling from an ice cave, and her whole body couldn't help but tremble slightly.

Lin Wennuan, who was still waiting on the side, was so scared that she cried and sat helplessly on the ground.

The invisible aura is centered on Lu Daosheng and instantly covers the entire Lin family villa.

Everyone felt a strong sense of suffocation.

At this moment, Linye no longer dared to open his eyes and talk lies.

With a plop.

Lin Ye knelt down at Lu Daosheng and said tremblingly: "Lu Daosheng, please spare me, this wine is indeed not passed down from my Lin family!"

really.

Lu Daosheng snorted, "So, where did this wine come from?"

Lin Ye took a deep breath, the fear in his eyes became a little lighter, he looked at Lu Daosheng, and said with a serious expression: "Mr. Lu, do you know if you have ever heard of God?"

God!

As soon as these words were said, Ma Ma on the other side suddenly became horrified and looked around suddenly, as if he would die of a life-threatening death in the next moment.

But as time passed by minute by minute and nothing happened, he breathed a sigh of relief.

Lu Daosheng looked at the forest in front of him and was silent for a moment. Lu Daosheng stood up and walked slowly towards the forest.

Forestry looked suspicious.

At this time, Lu Daosheng raised one foot and kicked Linye several meters away with one foot.

"If you talk nonsense to me, your Lin family doesn't need to exist!"

Lu Daosheng's cold and emotional voice came into Linye's ears.

Lin Ye looked sad and hurriedly dragged his painful body toward Lu Dao and said in a trembling voice: "Mr. Lu, ten years ago, a mysterious man who claimed to be from God came to Yunshan City. Because my Lin family was in great power at that time, he Living in the Lin family for a while.”

"He is very strong and has many methods that we have never heard of, so our Lin family greeted the existence very enthusiastically. Finally, before he left, in order to thank our Lin family, he gave us that jar. The wine, until now, Mr. Lu, you are here, I am willing to take it out.”

After listening to the story of forestry, Lu Daosheng fell into deep thought.

A mysterious man who claims to be from God?

God, what is this place?

Lu Daosheng didn't ask about forestry. I think this guy must have no idea what.

After thinking about it carefully, Lu Daosheng made an inference that it should be a powerful organization within the Blue Star.

It cannot be an existence outside of Blue Star.

There is no other possibility.

It seems that I need to move.

In Yunshan City, the Jiang family now has the help of the Lin family and the Li family, and it doesn’t take much time to rise again.

Perhaps there is really a systematic inspiration within God.

Thinking of the system, Lu Daosheng called the system softly again in his heart.

However, there was no response.

well.

With a sigh in his heart, Lu Daosheng glanced faintly at Lin Ye, the head of the Lin family, who was still somewhat surprised and suspicious.

Feeling Lu Daosheng's gaze, Lin Ye was shocked and asked quickly: "Mr. Lu has any questions, Lin must know everything!"

He was really afraid of Lu Daosheng.

He was afraid that Lu Daosheng would be unhappy and destroy his Lin family.

He believed that Lu Daosheng definitely had this strength.

At this time, Lu Daosheng slowly walked out of the house.

Seeing this, Lin Ye was slightly stunned and hurriedly stood up and said, "Mr. Lu, are you leaving?"

"I have no problem."

After leaving this sentence, Lu Daosheng left the Lin family directly.

In place, Linye finally recovered and then looked helplessly at his granddaughter, Lin Wennuan.

At this moment, Lin Wennuan's tense body was able to relax after Lu Daosheng left.

The feeling Lu Daosheng gave her was really terrible.

With such existence, my grandfather actually wanted her to be by her side. Isn’t this her life?

Fortunately, I didn't even have a chance.

So this matter was left alone.

Standing there, Linye, who had been silent for a long time, suddenly took out his cell phone and called him.

In just a moment, a very respectful voice came from the other end of the phone.

"Honor, what are the instructions?"

"From now on, all the resources of my Lin family will be inclined to the Jiang family for free. I will take someone to the Jiang family in person tomorrow."

Linye's expressionless face and his voice was a little cold.

But Lin Wennuan could hear a little helplessness in her grandfather's words.

The other end of the phone was silent for a moment before agreeing, "Yes, the head of the family."

After hanging up the phone, Linye slowly walked into the yard. At this moment, the full moon was hanging high and the evening breeze was blowing, and Linye felt mixed feelings in his heart.

Who would have thought that the Lin family, which was still in glory yesterday, would become a vassal of another family within one day.

A heavy sigh resounded throughout the courtyard.

And on the other side.

It was not until the second day that Lu Daosheng returned to the Jiang family's villa.

That's right, the Jiang family's villa was mortgaged in Lin Xu's hands.

After Lu Daosheng's beating, Lin Xu naturally returned the villa directly.

The efficiency is extremely fast.

"Hey, Brother Sheng, are you just back?"

As soon as Lu Daosheng entered the door, he saw Jiang Xiaoxiao who was cleaning up.

Looking at Lu Daosheng's appearance, Jiang Xiaoxiao didn't notice any abnormality, so she smiled and said, "Brother Sheng, have you had breakfast? I'll make it for you?"

Lu Daosheng waved his hand, "No need, where is the old man?"

"My grandpa is still sleeping and he drank a lot last night."

Thinking of this, Jiang Xiaoxiao's eyes were circling again and she looked at Lu Daosheng, "Brother Sheng, I haven't seen you for a few years. You are so good at drinking. Even grandpa can't drink you."

Upon hearing this, Lu Daosheng laughed, "If the old man is a little younger, I will be willing to give in to the disadvantage."

As soon as these words came out, a familiar voice came from the entrance of the stairs on the second floor.

"Hmph, just be sure you know."

"Grandpa, are you awake?!"

Mr. Jiang slowly walked down the stairs on the second floor.

Seeing this, Jiang Xiaoxiao hurriedly stepped forward to support her.
